getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.summary:
The overview is the first page after signing in. It tells you what needs attention, how the fleet
stands and what is left to set up.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.summary:
A node is a server that runs the ownsolid agent. The Nodes page lists every node with its
state and lets you add, change and remove them.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.summary:
A task is work the control plane sends to one node's agent, such as collecting its facts. The
Tasks page lists them, newest first.

model-library.title: Model library
model-library.summary:
The Model library holds the models of the workspace chosen in the switcher, and shows
how they arrive. A model arrives as a bundle, so importing one needs no network.

model-services.title: Model services
model-services.summary:
Model services shows the models the workspace in the switcher serves, and how each is
doing. A deployment runs one model on one whole GPU of one node, and is called by its model and
node. The tiles above the list count deployments by state and filter the list.

people-and-workspaces.title: People and workspaces
people-and-workspaces.summary:
People sign in to the console or the portal with their own accounts. Workspaces group people and
the work they share.

single-sign-on.title: Single sign-on
single-sign-on.summary:
Single sign-on lets people sign in with an account on your company's Gitea instead of a password
kept by ownsolid. The Single sign-on page manages the connectors.

audit-trail.title: Audit trail
audit-trail.summary:
Every privileged action is recorded. The Audit trail shows who did what, to what, when,
from where and with what outcome.

license.title: License
license.summary:
The license covers the whole platform; there are no paid modules. The License page shows
its state, expiry and limits, and imports a new one.

email.title: Email
email.summary:
The installation sends invitations, password resets and notices of password changes through your
mail server. Email shows each message's delivery.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary:
Settings holds choices an administrator makes for everyone in the tenant. Your own
choices are on your account.

account.title: Your account
account.summary: Your account holds your profile, your password and how ownsolid looks for you.

what-is-supported.title: What is supported
what-is-supported.summary:
What is supported lists every option the product offers, such as operating systems,
accelerators and installation sizes, and whether this release can use it.
